core_meaning.primary_meaning: Azeez is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Mighty, powerful, dear”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Azeez corresponds to the Arabic form عزيز (ع ز ز). Its core sense is mighty, powerful, strong. ʿAzīz ('mighty, powerful, dear'); al-ʿAzīz is one of the divine names.
